decisions.reason: The source changes minimum approval duration and required lesson value, not the permitted or required source material.
The source does not change clean-editing, effects, animation, or transition rules.
The duration impact is already fully represented by the same-message MODIFY setting minimum_approval_duration_seconds to 45.
The source contains no change to caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
Requiring a complete lesson or full value does not change the separate standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
The source does not discuss wind noise or any other audio-cleanup behavior.
The next-batch clip standard does not alter Lead Clipper assignment, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The source adds an approval criterion for individual clips but does not change the monthly quota, cadence, or rule that only approved clips count.
The qualification process was already completed, and the source applies to the next production batch rather than reopening or changing qualification.
The approval authority and rejected-clip workflow remain unchanged; the specific 45-second criterion is already owned by the atomic Clip Duration Requirement.
The rule that only approved clips may be published remains valid unchanged; the source does not change the destination, format, schedule, or authorized clip count.
The source changes clip acceptance criteria but not the submission channel, folder requirements, batch size, deadline, or review-link workflow.
